briefing: Markets were flat-to-slightly-down today (S&P -0.3%, Nasdaq -0.4%), a neutral session with no broad risk-on signal. Rather than forcing a buy just to deploy idle cash, we only bought MANE and GFS, the two candidates showing complete technical confirmation across RSI, MACD, price trend, and volume. Existing positions were left untouched to let stop-loss and profit-target rules work automatically.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Signal confluence means waiting until multiple independent indicators — like RSI, MACD, price trend, and trading volume — all point the same direction before acting. A single bullish signal can be noise, but when several line up together it's much more likely to reflect real buying interest rather than a random price blip.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 訊號匯聚是指等待多個獨立指標（如RSI、MACD、價格趨勢和成交量）同時指向同一方向後才採取行動。單一的看漲訊號可能只是噪音，但當多個指標同時出現時，更有可能反映真實的買盤動能，而不是隨機的價格波動。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today with no single dominant catalyst, consistent with a quiet, range-bound session. Without a strong macro trigger, individual stock-level technical signals became the more reliable guide for new positions. This kind of neutral tape often precedes either a continuation of consolidation or a breakout once a clearer catalyst emerges.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤小幅走低，未見明顯的單一催化因素，呈現區間整理的格局。在缺乏強烈宏觀驅動力的情況下，個股層面的技術訊號成為挑選新倉位更可靠的依據。這種中性盤勢通常預示著整理行情的延續，或是等待更明確的催化劑出現後才會突破。
